name: Tinderbox
description: A compact kit for reliably lighting fires without relying on improvisation.

name: Lantern

narrative_effects: Provides reliable light in darkness when supplied with oil.

name: Lantern Hood
description: A fitted hood attachment that controls and narrows lantern light.
narrative_effects: Controls and directs lantern light output for concealment or focus.

name: Fishing Line and Hook

narrative_effects: Required to attempt fishing as food or resource gathering without crude improvisation.

name: Bedroll

name: Tent (2-person)

narrative_effects: Supports probing, reaching, and testing unsafe spaces without direct contact.

name: Shovel

name: Backpack

name: Pouch

name: Collection Pouch

name: Sack

name: Barrel

name: Basket

name: Waterskin

name: Flask

name: Vial

name: Quiver

name: Saddlebag

name: Feed Bag

name: Chisel

name: Hammer

name: Mallet

name: Pliers

name: Wire (coil)

name: Mortar and Pestle

name: Measuring Spoon (set)

name: Loupe

name: Brushes (set)

name: Straight Edge

name: Compass

name: Splint

name: Paper (sheet)

name: Ink Pen

name: Book (blank)

name: Map

name: Spyglass

name: Robe

name: Mirror (steel)

name: Signal Whistle

narrative_effects: Supports audible signaling and coordinated movement or response.

name: Field Rations (per day)

narrative_effects: Required to avoid hunger penalties during extended travel without other food sources.

name: Torch

name: Adhesive

name: Pigments (set)

name: Thread

name: Ink (bottle)

name: Perfume (vial)
